specs.title: Remote Lookup Batch Interface

drifted.spec_text: The IRemoteLookup interface MUST expose a batch_lookup method with signature fn batch_lookup(&self, entries: &[(CacheKey, IpcHandle)]) -> Vec<Result<(), RemoteLookupError>>.
drifted.actual: Signature is fn batch_lookup(&self, entries: &[(CacheKey, u32)]) -> Vec<Result<(), RemoteLookupError>> -- IpcHandle removed, replaced by an expected-size u32 (per 002 Clarification Q1).

drifted.spec_text: Each entry in batch_lookup MUST produce a log message via the ILogger receptacle (placeholder behavior).
drifted.actual: No per-entry log call exists; batch_lookup submits to the actor, which SHOUTs a KEY_QUERY instead of logging each entry.

drifted.spec_text: When connected, the placeholder implementation MUST return Err(RemoteLookupError::NotFound) for each entry (no actual network I/O).
drifted.actual: Real network I/O occurs: zyre SHOUT/WHISPER plus one-sided RDMA writes via the initiator/responder receptacles.

drifted.spec_text: The component MUST expose functionality only through the IRemoteLookup interface -- no public functions outside the interface.
drifted.actual: RemoteLookupComponent has three pub fns outside IRemoteLookup: peers_seen, signal_shutdown, shutdown.

drifted.spec_text: The placeholder implementation MUST log the endpoint and return Ok(()).
drifted.actual: join_cluster routes to the actor (ActorMsg::Join) which really calls node.join; returns Err if uninitialized rather than always Ok.

drifted.spec_text: The placeholder implementation MUST log the call and return Ok(()).
drifted.actual: leave_cluster really leaves the zyre group via the actor; returns Err if uninitialized.

drifted.spec_text: The interface compiles with the same (CacheKey, IpcHandle) parameter types as IDispatcher::batch_lookup.
drifted.actual: IDispatcher::batch_lookup still uses IpcHandle; IRemoteLookup::batch_lookup uses u32. dispatcher-p2p explicitly converts between them before calling remote-lookup.

not_implemented: IpcHandle key entity -- 002 removes it entirely from the IRemoteLookup boundary; remote-lookup is CPU/DRAM-only and no longer carries a GPU DMA handle.

specs.title: Remote Lookup over Zyre + RDMA

drifted.spec_text: On RDMA_STATUS(UnableToConnect | KeyNoLongerAvailable) for a key ... the actor MUST NOT yet reclaim the landing slot if a late write could still be in flight (see FR-014).
drifted.actual: on_rdma_status reclaims the slot immediately on any failure status, matching contracts/wire-protocol.md ('frees a slot exposed to a peer only on (1) RDMA_STATUS received, or (2) peer Exit after DisconnectAck') rather than FR-009's more conservative prose.

drifted.spec_text: The component MUST declare receptacles for IZyre, IDispatchMap, IMemoryTier, IDispatcher, IRemoteLookupRdmaInitiator, IRemoteLookupRdmaResponder, and ILogger.
drifted.actual: The component declares 8 receptacles: the same 7 plus responder_admin: IRemoteLookupRdmaResponderAdmin (required by FR-025). responder_admin is documented in data-model.md/contracts/iremote_lookup.md/tasks.md -- only spec.md's FR-023 list omits it.

not_implemented: tasks.md T025 (User Story 7 mesh test): a tests/mesh.rs scenario for peer Exit during an operation -- cached-reply drop, in-progress-to-unsatisfied transition, and DisconnectAck-gated slot reclaim (backs SC-005/SC-006). The underlying implementation (ActorState::on_exit, ::teardown_peer) exists and reviews as correct, but no such test exists in tests/mesh.rs -- a test-coverage gap, not a missing feature.

unspecced.feature: RemoteLookupComponent::peers_seen() -- public peer-count accessor used as a test discovery barrier
unspecced.suggested_spec: Document as an out-of-interface test/observability hook in 002's Key Entities, or restrict to test builds if no production caller needs it.

unspecced.feature: RemoteLookupComponent::signal_shutdown() -- non-blocking actor-stop signal for two-phase multi-node teardown
unspecced.suggested_spec: Add an explicit teardown-ordering FR to 002 covering multiple actors sharing a zyre/czmq context; it is used in production wiring (apps/certus-server), not just tests.

unspecced.feature: RemoteLookupComponent::shutdown() -- public join-actor-and-worker teardown, also invoked from Drop
unspecced.suggested_spec: Add a component-teardown/Drop-ordering FR to 002 (actor joined before worker, so the worker's channel closes deterministically).

conflicts.description: 001-remote-lookup-placeholder's spec.md header reads 'Status: Synced (2026-06-19)' but 002-remote-lookup-rdma explicitly supersedes it and the shipped code implements 002's contract (different batch_lookup signature, real network I/O), not 001's placeholder behavior.

FR-009 in 002's spec.md and contracts/wire-protocol.md disagree on when a landing slot exposed to a live peer may be reclaimed after a failure status; the code follows the contract, not FR-009's literal prose.
